description: Java source code for MainActivity class in an Android application that manages Bluetooth support and fragment setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Bluetooth management, handling Bluetooth support checks and fragment setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, checks Bluetooth support and state, and sets up UI fragments if supported.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from Bluetooth enable request, proceeds or terminates based on user action.

methods.name: setupFragments
methods.description: Sets up and displays Bluetooth scanner and advertiser fragments.

methods.name: showErrorText
methods.description: Displays an error message to the user based on a resource string ID.
